ideas.pitch: An offline-first clinical triage assistant combining rPPG heart rate extraction through standard webcams and multilingual clinical triage for rural health camps.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines non-contact vital sign monitoring with clinical-grade multilingual triage, directly mirroring a proven hackathon-winning architecture while solving a concrete resource-constrained healthcare problem.
